'''2026 Retro World Championship''' was the [[Players Committee]]'s Retro ([[Premiere - Death Star II]]) championship held alongside the [[2026 World Championship]] in Bloomington, Minnesota, during the weekend of 23–25 October 2026.<ref name="worlds2026">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-11-swccg-world-championship-bloomington-minnesota-oct-23-25-2026/ 2026-11 SWCCG World Championship – Bloomington, Minnesota (Oct. 23-25, 2026)], [[Players Committee]] (27 October 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114003052/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-11-swccg-world-championship-bloomington-minnesota-oct-23-25-2026.html Internet Archive].</ref> [[Will Tarbox]] won ahead of [[Alex Prodoehl]].<ref name="retro2026">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-12-swccg-retro-event-at-worlds-prem-ds2-bloomington-minnesota-oct-23-25-2026/ 2026-12 SWCCG Retro Event at Worlds – Prem-DS2 Bloomington, Minnesota (Oct. 23-25, 2026)], [[Players Committee]] (2 November 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114003208/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-12-swccg-retro-event-at-worlds-prem-ds2-bloomington-minnesota-oct-23-25-2026.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' Bloomington, Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 23–25 October 2026 (World Championship weekend)<ref name="worlds2026" />
